one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Marketing API) has a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0 3-legged auth; access requires app creation and Advertising API approval, with tiered Development/Standard access; only community MCP servers exist.
auth_notes: Authorization code (3-legged) flow with rw_ads / r_ads scopes; Token Generator tool in developer portal for testing tokens. Refresh tokens supported.
access_notes: Developer app is self-serve, but Advertising API product must be applied for and approved. Development tier allows read on unlimited accounts and edit on up to 5 ad accounts; Standard tier (separate application, vetting) needed for unlimited edit. API is free of charge.
blocker_notes: Advertising API access requires LinkedIn approval via the Products tab; Standard tier upgrade needed for production multi-account write access.

evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0 three-legged (authorization code) flow — the flow every Marketing API call uses.
All applications start with Development tier. You must apply separately to upgrade to the Standard tier.
API calls succeed only when made with correct scopes/permissions assigned to the app after the vetting process.
These APIs provide all features available in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including creation and management of ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, ad types, and analytics.
There's no official LinkedIn MCP. This fills the gap with a thin, correctness-first wrapper
